## Key claims (as stated in source)
- As part of plans announced during the **2024 Forum on China-Africa Cooperation (FOCAC) Summit**, the **first-ever Regional Cooperation Center for China-Africa Digital Education** was launched (Friday, Feb 7, 2025) at the **Open University of Kenya** in Machakos County, together with an **Open Learning Center**.
- The collaboration is between the **Open University of China, Donghua University, and the Open University of Kenya**.
- Stated focus: staff capacity-building, development of academic and nonacademic programs, co-offering of programs, cultural exchange.
- Five-year horizon mentioned for establishing the centers and staff capacity-building; the three universities will meet to design courses for international populations.
- Donghua University (technology-focused) to collaborate with OUK's schools of education and science; joint online programs to "break geographical barriers."

## Verification notes
- Consistent with draft.md usage (Kenya digital education center, FOCAC follow-up).
- State-media report of an institutional launch; quotes from university officials. No quantitative targets beyond the five-year horizon.
